name: LightRAG
ontology_notes: Document Graph-RAG. ExtractedEntity and ExtractedRelationship in lightrag/types.py (entity_name, entity_type, relationship_description). Query modes naive, local, global, hybrid, mix. Workspace is a storage namespace for a knowledge base, not a person. No user/character/relationship companion types.

ontology.evidence: lightrag/types.py ExtractedEntity/ExtractedRelationship/KnowledgeGraph. README dual-level KG plus vector chunks. Entity types are LLM-emitted strings, not companion roles.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Indexing pipeline: chunk, LLM entity-relation extract, merge into graph and vector stores. Operator inserts documents. Incremental insert and document delete rebuild affected entities using LLM cache (README).
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: README query modes local, global, hybrid, naive, mix. mix merges KG and chunk retrieval into the answer LLM. Empty graph yields no KG context. /workspace UI is query-only, not a security boundary.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: Document delete rebuilds entities/relations from remaining docs. No fact-level isLatest. Re-inserting a changed document is the update path.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: No validity windows or last-Tuesday queries in README query modes. Timestamps are not a retrieval operator.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Workspace isolates knowledge bases (lightrag/constants.py workspace-scoped locks). One workspace is one entity-relation bag. No user vs character vs relationship.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Retrieval is embedding plus graph adjacency. ENABLE_AI_CONTENT_NOTICE only labels answers as AI-generated. No social skip.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Corpus text is extracted into entities that later sit in the prompt. README does not document trust tags. GraphRAG-style injection testing is not claimed here.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: README selective deletion: delete a document and rebuild affected entities/relations from LLM cache. That is corpus delete, not user forget-that on a relationship fact.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Index: LLM extract per chunk (heavy). Query: local/global retrieve then QUERY LLM on entities+relations+chunks. MAX_ENTITY_TOKENS/MAX_RELATION_TOKENS/MAX_TOTAL_TOKENS cap prompt. Four LLM roles (extract vs query vs others) in README.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: MIT. Default KV/vector/graph are in-memory with file persistence (README: not for production). Local embedding BAAI/bge-m3 recommended. Can run with local LLMs. Postgres recommended for production.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: README documents API server, WebUI, and Python. No official MCP server named in the README.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: LightRAG is document Graph-RAG. Entities and relations cannot tell user from character from relationship. Query injects graph context into an answer model. People cargo-cult this into roleplay. It will mix lore, user facts, and persona into one workspace graph.

published_eval.name: LightRAG paper (EMNLP 2025), arXiv 2410.05779
published_eval.claimed_score: Paper reports dual-level graph RAG vs naive RAG on document QA (comprehensiveness/diversity). README does not publish LoCoMo/LongMemEval numbers.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Corpus question answering and RAG quality, not companion memory, identity drift, or silence.

open_unknowns: Whether a community MCP wrapper exists (not scored as official).
Numeric table values from the paper (not copied here; abstract does not list them).
